dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Welcome to Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse! Come have a look at our flowers in full bloom! They're perfect as gifts, or to brighten up your rooms!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any regular flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Regular flowers? Oh, like ones that need soil and water? We do, but wow, those are so troublesome to take care of, and you can't squeeze them like this... But hey, if regular's your speed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: These flowers... look rather special.

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, of course they are! These are made from the best white iron alloys that money can buy. I guarantee you won't find their equal anywhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: And taking care of them's super simple. Forget water, all you need are a few drops of engine oil every now and then to keep them glossy and shiny! How's that for a bargain?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Alrighty, goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Could you kindly get me a metal flower?

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: You're... the Lady Moonchanter... Are you also fond of these flowers I make?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: A friend of mine is most fond, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lauma tells Richeza about what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I see. Never thought my work would catch the eye of a little bird.

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Well, take one on the house — consider it a gift from me to that wee birdie. This one's particularly small, so it should be a cinch to carry around.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: On behalf of that child, thank you for your generosity, which I gladly accept.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Could you kindly get me a metal flower?

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Sure... Huh? You are...

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: (I think I've seen this child before, on Moon Prayer Night...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I have a friend who's really interested in metal flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Columbina tells Richeza about what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I see. Never thought my work would catch the eye of a little bird.

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Well, take one on the house — consider it a gift from me to that wee birdie. This one's particularly small, so it should be a cinch to carry around.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Thank you for this, and on behalf of that little bird too.
